name: Lightweight FPS gaming mouse
summary: A lightweight, wired or low-latency wireless mouse with a modern optical sensor is the most common upgrade for players who want more consistent aim. The goal is comfort and control, not the highest number on the box.
lookFor: Weight: lighter shapes are easier to flick and stop, but heavier ones can feel steadier for some grips
Shape and size matched to your hand length and grip style (palm, claw or fingertip)
Polling rate of at least 1000 Hz and a sensor that does not smooth or accelerate movement
Reliable, tactile main buttons and a scroll wheel with clear steps
Cable flexibility if wired, or a trusted low-latency wireless dongle if wireless
suitableFor: Players of tactical and arena shooters who practice aim regularly and want a mouse that disappears in the hand.
pros: Can make small adjustments easier and less tiring
Transfers across every game you play
cons: Fit is personal, so a popular shape can still feel wrong to you
Wireless models cost more and need charging
